<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

When joint effects project to local effects, initial evidence covers projections, both local plans work and recursive joint executability holds, the zipped plan achieves both endpoint requirements.

Canonical source: [JointContinuation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/JointContinuation.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Two projections of one history X, a common finite horizon, project, initial coverage, both local works hypotheses and compatible.

Actual joint effects must remain covered by local laws; every subsequent observation branch must be executable.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

Two locally successful two-step plans on the same two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step; separate success or serialization alone does not repair this.
